New Zealand looked in a bit of bother when they lost their experienced pair of Tom Latham and Kane Williamson early but Jeet Raval, the debutant has looked good scoring a fifty. Ross Taylor's poor run continued but Henry Nicholls has given good support to Raval to see through the day for the hosts. They trail by only 29 runs and will look to post a big first innings total and look to force an innings victory. That's a long way off for now.

That ends an entertaining day of Test cricket! 13 wickets have fallen in the day. New Zealand won a crucial toss and inserted Pakistan in. The tourists did start sedately before the debutant Colin de Grandhomme made his first impact. He castled Azhar Ali and since that moment, Pakistan never recovered to get bundled out for a score of 133. Colin finished with best figures on Test debut for a New Zealand bowler, 6 for 41.
